title: Khuda ki pehchan banke jabse
body:
Khuda ki pehchan banke jabse
Khuda ki pehchan banke jabse mujhe ta'arruf hua hasan ka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
samajh me aane laga hai tab se mujhe bhi kuch kuch khuda hasan ka
Batool e azra ki god me wo nuzool jab kar chuka hasan ka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ali ke hoto se kaam lekar khuda ne bosa liya hasan ka
Ali ke pehle hi waaste par khuda ne sunli jo baat meri..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
to maine agli dua ki khatir bacha liya waasta hasan ka
Abhi charagho ka silsila to janab e mehdi(a.t.s.f) talak chalega..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Abhi to zehra ke ghar me roshan hua hai pehla diya hasan ka
Laqab badalne se shaam walo kabhi muqaddar nahi badalte..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Faqeer khudko ameer likhle na hoga hum martaba hasan ka
Ye mera jibreel fikr akbar maqam e sidra se kya badhega..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
dimaagh chota sha'oor adna mai kya likhu martaba hasan ka
Khuda ki pehchan banke jabse mujhe ta'arruf hua hasan ka
<<DIVIDER>>
samajh me aane laga hai tab se mujhe bhi kuch kuch khuda hasan ka
author: Mir Hassan Mir
